title: TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening
abstract: arXiv:2608.16122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.

translated_title: TokenSTFormer：一种用于青少年特发性脊柱侧弯筛查中整体运动分析的标记化时空注意力模型
translated_abstract: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）是一种常见的青少年脊柱畸形，若未及时治疗，可能导致严重的健康后果。传统筛查方法受限于主观解读、依赖专业知识和可扩展性低。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ScoliGait数据集，包含1,516个步态视频片段及其对应的X光记录。我们还引入了TokenSTFormer，这是一种新颖的模型，通过标记化空间和时间语义来增强特征表示和收敛性。我们的模型达到了最先进的性能，在关键指标上超越了普通视觉变换器编码器，包括准确率达0.79。本研究凸显了利用步态视频中的整体运动特征和基于注意力的模型进行可扩展、低成本AIS筛查的潜力，为未来脊柱侧弯检测的临床应用铺平了道路。
tldr: 本文提出TokenSTFormer模型和ScoliGait数据集，通过标记化时空注意力机制从步态视频中提取整体运动特征，实现了高准确率（0.79）的青少年特发性脊柱侧弯自动筛查。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TokenSTFormer and the ScoliGait dataset, leveraging tokenized spatial-temporal attention to extract holistic motion features from gait videos, achieving high accuracy (0.79) for automated adolescent idiopathic scoliosis screening.
